_comment: Vendor lifecycle catalog. Each entry's `match` is a case-insensitive regex tested against 'manufacturer model mpn name version purl' of a component. The stage is recomputed from the milestone dates every time the catalog is applied, so the same catalog moves a part from active to end-of-sale to end-of-support as time passes. ENTRIES MARKED sample:true ARE ILLUSTRATIVE, NOT VENDOR-CONFIRMED DATES. Replace them with the vendor's published end-of-life notice (and put its URL in `source`) before relying on them. Software entries can come from endoflife.date via `python3 -m ibom_ingest eol --endoflife ubuntu`.
